sanskrit: saṃvedyavarjitamanuttamamādyamekaṃ saṃvitpadaṃ vikalanaṃ kalayanmahātman / hṛdyeva tiṣṭha kalanārahitaḥ kriyāṃ tu kurvannakartṛpadametya śamoditaśrīḥ //
english: Rama! renounce the cognizance of the knowable objects, and depend on the abstract knowledge of all things in thy subjective consciousness; remain firm in full possession of thy inner soul, and think thyself as no actor of thy acts. Then forsaking all inventions of men as falsehoods (kalana and kalpana), shine with the effulgence of thy spiritual light.
